To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
autoclaving treatment can be recommended for the effective utilization of sword bean seeds as a protein supplement in the diets of animals and humans.

the autoclaving treatment is more effective in reducing antinutritional factors without affecting the nutritional quality of SB seeds, and the rats fed with the diet containing autoclaving-treated SB seeds as a sole source of protein exhibited better growth performance than the rats fed with control and other treatments.

the autoclaving treatment is more effective in reducing antinutritional components of sword bean seeds without affecting their nutritional quality, which could be recommended for their use in human and animal diets.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the nutritional value, protein quality and biological value of the raw and differentially treated sword bean seeds.
the nutritional evaluation and protein quality of sword bean seeds.

the evaluation of the nutritional value, biological value and antinutritional components of sword bean (SB), an underutilized legume, in order to determine its potential as an alternative source of protein in human nutrition.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the autoclaving treatment has the maximum potential to reduce the antinutritional factors in the SB seeds, while retaining the nutritional quality of SB seed protein, and thus, the SB seeds can be used as a protein source in the diet of both human and animal.

the autoclaving treatment has been more effective in improving the protein quality of sword bean seeds by reducing the maximum levels (91%) of various antinutrional compounds such as total phenolics, tannins, L-Dopa, phytic acid, raffinose, stachyose, verbascose, haemagglutinins, trypsin inhibitor and a-amylas inhibitor activity without affecting the nutritional quality.
the SB seeds can be considered as an alternative/addition source of food protein for both humans and animals, provided the SB seeds are processed by autoclaving treatment.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
sword bean seeds could be utilized for food and feed after proper processing.
the autoclaving treatment of SB seeds was found more effective in reducing various antinutrients and increasing the nutritional value without affecting the protein quality of the seed materials.

the autoclaving treatment of sword bean seeds is a promising method to reduce the antinutritional factors and improve the nutritional value, biological value and the protein quality of sword bean seeds.
The main takeaway from our work is that
sword bean seeds can be utilized as a protein source in the diet of human being and animal after proper processing.
the sword bean (SB), which is under-utilized and under-researched in South India, can be a good source of proteins.

autoclaving is the best processing method to improve the nutritional value and protein content of SB seeds, which can be utilized as a novel protein ingredient in human/animal diets to improve the nutritional status and to meet the increasing global demand for proteins.
